name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
"Your fortune awaits you outside Palemane Rock."

The fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch.  Grasping it firmly, you see an image of the Palemane Rock of Mulgore.  Focusing closer in on the image, you see a tree stump that sits close to the cave entrance.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Palemane Rock in Mulgore and seek out your fortune.
narrative.offerRewardText: A quick search of the tree stump reveals a lockbox from within it!  It would seem that you have found your fortune!
narrative.requestItemsText: This tree stump looks like the one from your vision.
